notes: §2002:14.8.6.3 GR5: CLOSE RPT WITH LOCK with an active report completes (status 00, lock holds: REOPEN=38) and sets EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED (EXCEPTION-STATUS, checking ON). --std 2002 run matched. §2002:9.1.12: a 38 status is fatal and the implementor decides whether execution continues; DOC-A.1-103: it continues, because RPT has a FILE STATUS clause and EC-I-O checking is not enabled.
